title.en: An Act Making the Sitio Called Guintabu-An, in the Municipality of Saravia, Province of Occidental Negros, a National Park.

text.en:
The sitio called Guintabu-an, in the municipality of Saravia, Province of Occidental Negros, is
hereby made a national park and a committee is created, composed of the president of Saravia and two other
members designated by the municipal council of said municipality, which committee shall locate said sitio of
Guintabu-an and endeavor to obtain from its owners the donation of an area of not less than four hectares
thereof. This committee shall submit its report to the Legislature not later than ten clays after the inauguration
of the Tenth Legislature.

This Act shall take effect in accordance with section eleven of the Administrative Code.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
